# oxvif 0.17.0 vendored library

This directory contains the published `oxvif` 0.17.0 library source under the MIT license.
Non-library targets and extended project documentation are omitted from this vendor copy.

The [upstream 0.17.0 source](https://github.com/smiti1642/oxvif/tree/v0.17.0) provides the
complete guides, command-line tools, release history, contribution policy, and security policy.
[`../README.md`](../README.md) records the exact local hardening changes and replacement policy.
[`LICENSE`](LICENSE) is the authoritative license and attribution notice.
